venues.name: Research Ethics
venues.scope_notes: Research ethics, scientific integrity, research regulation and ethics-review processes. Theoretical original articles and critical reviews allow work based on existing evidence; new clinical studies are unnecessary. Original empirical articles normally have a 7,000-word limit, theoretical articles 5,000, and reviews 3,000–6,000. Letters receive editorial review and are not automatically peer-reviewed research articles. An AI statement is mandatory in every submission, including an explicit statement of no AI use where applicable. Preprints are accepted but must not be updated during review; accepted work requires a final-publication link. The journal-specific AI statement requirement is stricter than Sage's general assistive-editing disclosure exemption.

route.conditions: Current Community Open Access policy explicitly excludes author costs and an APC after acceptance; support does not require the submitting author's institution to participate. The journal is online-only. Empirical original articles normally permit 7,000 words, theoretical articles 5,000 and reviews 3,000–6,000, excluding references; longer work needs editorial justification. All submissions require an AI-use statement, including when no AI was used. The current official page says no author cost under Community OA, but its post-acceptance boilerplate still discusses paying an APC where applicable, and an older official PDF says an APC is payable. Submission fees and the apparent inconsistency require confirmation.
route.other_mandatory_costs: Unclear: current no-author-cost wording conflicts with generic payment boilerplate and an older official PDF; submission fee not expressly resolved.

fee_evidence.note: Current journal-specific Community OA policy excludes author costs without an affiliation condition. Instructions establish online-only publication, article-specific length limits and a mandatory AI statement. Uppercase official URL was accessible after lowercase URL timed out.

venues.audit_note: Independently read the current uppercase REA author-instructions page, metric page and Sage definitions.
